items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: Well, I wouldn't have thought of Trixie and Clara --

ctx.x: Those girls there, they were older than you, for the most part. I think every one that we mentioned --
Well, I wouldn't have thought of Trixie and Clara --
Right, now, as the '20s went by, as it got older, and towards -- in the era, in the time when you were making records with Louie Armstrong, '26 and '27.
